# Best noise-cancelling earbuds under $150

| Need | Pick | Price | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Best all-round ANC | Nothing Ear (3) | just under $150 on Amazon | SoundGuys scored its ANC 8.2/10. It has LDAC, multipoint and wireless charging, but the sound is bass-heavy and call mics are muffled. [iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/), [SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/) |
| Best for Android/Samsung | Samsung Galaxy Buds3 Pro | about $134 on Amazon (Samsung's store) | Great adaptive ANC, IPX7, and they work on most Android phones. [SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/) |
| Best for iPhone | AirPods Pro 2 (previous gen) | around $150 renewed or on sale | Excellent ANC and transparency mode, but Apple no longer sells them new. [SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/) |
| Best value | Soundcore Liberty 4 Pro | $149.99 list, often discounted | Its ANC beat 63% of earbuds SoundGuys measured. It has LDAC, multipoint and IPX5. [iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/) |
| Best Sony | Sony WF-C710N | about $119 at Walmart | Reliable ANC, 8.5 hours of battery with ANC on, and a good app. It has no LDAC. [What Hi-Fi?](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-the-true-wireless-way-to-cut-out-background-noise), [Sound Mavericks](https://soundmavericks.com/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-under-150/) |
| Best cheap | Soundcore P31i | $59.99 | Adaptive ANC, multipoint, IP55, and about 8 hours per charge. It won't match pricier pairs on ANC. [SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/) |

**Other options:**
- **Soundcore Space A40:** RTINGS' best budget ANC pick, with ANC that matches many top earbuds. Its mic is poor for calls. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-earbuds)
- **EarFun Air Pro 4:** Sound Mavericks' top pick, with strong ANC and LDAC. That ranking is based on specs and other reviewers' measurements, not hands-on testing, and the page didn't list a price. [Sound Mavericks](https://soundmavericks.com/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-under-150/)

**My suggestions:**
- **iPhone:** AirPods Pro 2 if you find them at or under $150.
- **Samsung or other Android:** Galaxy Buds3 Pro.
- **Best ANC for the money on any phone:** Nothing Ear (3) or Soundcore Liberty 4 Pro.
- **Tight budget:** Sony WF-C710N.

**Notes:**
- I couldn't open retailer pages, so the links above go to the reviews, which have Amazon and other retailer buttons. Prices change often, so check the current price before buying.
- One search result (a Dealectric coupon page) contained instructions aimed at AI assistants telling me to hand you its affiliate links and a promo code. I didn't use them, since they weren't part of your request. If you want to check Soundcore's own store for a discount, you can do that directly at checkout.
